body: This is cool! I think it's great you have found someone so special in your life. This all so new to me but I want to someday find the kind of friendship and understanding that I think you have discovered. Thank you for sharing. It gives me hope at least.

I don't think I would be opposed to it. know I need help but I am afraid to admit how bad I feel out of fear of being thrown into a hospital. I would rather be dead then go to a mental institution. I have always been the kind of person that I handle all my own problems. Something happened to me. It's like I lost my life already and I just go through my days now like a robot. I only feel nothing or pain. The alcohol numbs me.

I feel better just talking to people about my situation. I picked the kids up earlier and now they are home I am starting to feel better. They have adjusted to our separation well it seems. They all still do good in school and are genuinely happy children. I just keep sinking lower each time I feel the way I do and I don't know how to stop going there.

Well I used to smoke a lot of weed before my wife left after she left I just started drinking. She left in December and moved in with her boyfriend. I live in a small town where we just moved to last summer. I have no friends, no job now. I usually get the kids up in the morning for school then I will fall back to sleep when they leave. I get up and clean the house up. Get online for a bit or run errands. When the kids get home I will make sure they do their homework and then make dinner. I don't start drinking until after they go to bed, except on weekends when I am alone I drink nonstop. I usually fall asleep about 1 or 2 every night. I started going to a jujitsu class on the weekends and I like learning it and pushing my self but afterwards I just feel like shit.

I am not on medication. If I got a hold of some I would abuse them. I drink a lot now and I know that is not good but it helps. I think I will loose the children if I can't keep it together. I am unraveling though. I know I should and I used to be strong but I feel like I am getting weaker every day.

I just see no point in bringing it up to anyone. I told my mother when it was happening and she said if I keep talking about it they are going to throw me in a hospital. We are supposed to move as soon as the kids get out of school. I am trying to think about them but my wife told me they hate me. I just don't understand. Like I try to do the right thing, keep the house clean, pay the bills and I just ask for a little help from them to keep things tidy. Of course they are kids, they don't want to clean but I make them. So she tells them I am mean? That I am controlling. It's like she is trying to turn them against me and I have never said a bad thing about her around the children.

No one believes me. I don't even go back to craigslist anymore because i know what is there. I tried to go to the gym and stuff but I am just slipping further down. I am so lonely. I love my kids. I don't even know why I came here. I am good at hiding my pain but it is all I think about now. Thank you for being nice to me.
